title: Fridays for Future climate protest held in Berlin
seoTitle: Berlin Fridays for Future climate protest

tea.why: Protesters gathered to demand stronger action against the climate crisis during the UN climate change conference.
tea.want: Industrialized nations must provide more funding to help developing countries adapt to global warming.
tea.changed: Nov 13: Several hundred people demonstrated in Berlin outside the Chancellery with illuminated letters.

summary: Organised by the environmental movement Fridays for Future, protesters gathered in Berlin outside the Chancellery to demand stronger measures against the climate crisis. The demonstration coincided with the UN climate conference in Turkey and featured illuminated letters spelling 'Pay Your Climate Debt' alongside a lantern walk through the government district. Organisers criticized Federal Chancellor Friedrich Merz for not attending the summit, calling his absence a poor signal to the global community. The movement called on Germany and other industrialized states to increase financial support for developing countries dealing with global warming. Nationwide actions took place across approximately 70 locations, with police estimating about 1,000 participants in Berlin, while organisers claimed around 3,500 people joined the march.
demands: Increase funding for developing nations to adapt to global warming
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: Fridays for Future stated around 3,500 people took part, while police reported about 1,000 participants.

updates.text: Fridays for Future held a protest outside the Chancellery in Berlin with illuminated letters and a lantern walk.
